question: In Slack: Archive the private channel whose purpose mentions onboarding new hires and that has Diego Alvarez as a member. If there isn't one, just tell me.
final:
No such channel
exists. I checked all non-archived private channels in the workspace, and there's only one: `budget-planning` — its purpose is "Quarterly budget planning and forecast reviews", which doesn't mention onboarding new hires (and Diego Alvarez isn't in scope there either).

So there was nothing to archive.
